How the runs work.

Each run starts headless in a clean project with only the one skill installed. Pushes, releases, deploys and outbound submissions are denied, so nothing a run does reaches the outside world. Some tasks use prepared examples with a known answer; others work on this site. The result is graded against the rubric on its page, and the hard checks pass or fail on their own.

A verdict belongs to the task on its page, not to every use of the skill. PARTIAL means the run did real work and left something out; the page says what. Cost is what the agent's run cost, as Claude Code reported it.
